info.title: Traigent Economics Routes
info.description: Two tenant-scoped economics routes at DIFFERENT maturities, stated per route because one file-level label would misdescribe one of them. `POST /api/v1/economics/telemetry` is IMPLEMENTED — TraigentBackend serves it and validates its own responses against these schema files. `POST /api/v1/economics/recommendation` is CONTRACT-FIRST and UNIMPLEMENTED — no backend computes it; it is published ahead of the service per the workspace rule that request/response shapes start in TraigentSchema. The file-level `x-stability` / `x-asserted-against-backend` below are unchanged and are now the CONSERVATIVE FLOOR across both routes rather than a description of either: accurate for the recommendation route, understating the telemetry route, whose classification flip is an owner-level release-posture call flagged separately (#343). Where the two differ, the per-operation description is authoritative. No per-operation `x-stability` is set: the canonical vocabulary is {stable, pre-release, experimental, deprecated}, and choosing between them for the live telemetry route IS the owner-gated classification call, so inventing a value to describe the difference would pre-empt it.

post.summary: Compute an economics recommendation from a closed characterization submission
post.description: Accepts one closed characterization submission (the five bands, optional typed overrides, per-field provenance/confidence/evidence, and the client-side sharing policy — no presentation-only string of any kind) and returns the backend-authoritative recommendation: archetype, the dominant value channel WHEN the archetype is determined (an `undetermined` archetype carries no channel, because a channel the client withheld must not be invented), recommended daily build budget with floor/cap and a conservative lower-bound basis, a structured payback statement, stop rule, required receipt, the first-class spend-$0 case, and a structured `why` the agent renders in the user's own terms. The recommendation is independent of pricing, credits, sales incentives, and wallet/billing state, and every dollar figure is a labelled starting assumption. Tenant/project are resolved from the authenticated context; the body carries no tenant field.

200.description: Recommendation computed. The body is the backend-authoritative recommendation and always carries the spend-$0 case. An all-withheld or under-specified submission is answered 200 with an `undetermined` archetype, no value channel, and the spend-$0 case — withholding is never itself a 422.

403.description: Insufficient permission to request a recommendation for this scope.

422.description: The submission is well-formed but cannot be answered at all — for example contradictory duplicate field reports for one characterization field. NOT the withholding case: An all-withheld or under-specified submission is answered 200 with an `undetermined` archetype, no value channel, and the spend-$0 case — withholding is never itself a 422. No recommendation is ever fabricated from withheld values.

503.description: The recommendation service is temporarily unavailable; the client should retry rather than proceed without a recommendation.

post.x-wrap-status: unclassified — economics recommendation is not in the #136 wrap-map; the documented 200 response is the bare recommendation shape. Reconcile envelope status when the backend service lands.
post.x-traigent-note: Tenant/project scoping is resolved from the authenticated request context. The contract carries no tenant field precisely so a client cannot assert one. The MCP survey tool calls this contract; presentation phrasing and MCP transport mechanics are out of scope here.

post.summary: Ingest a batch of economics telemetry events
post.description: Accepts one idempotent batch of exposure-funnel events, run-economics records, and machine-verifiable receipts. Idempotent: replaying a batch with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original result (200) instead of re-applying it; a first ingest returns 201. IMPLEMENTED: TraigentBackend serves this route today and validates its own responses against these schema files. The file-level `x-asserted-against-backend: false` understates that; flipping the classification is an owner-level release-posture decision (flagged in #343) and is deliberately not taken here.

200.description: Batch replayed — this idempotency key was already ingested; no new state was written. The body binds replayed=true (replay response schema), so status and flag cannot disagree.

201.description: Batch ingested — state written now. Individual events may still have been rejected; read counts and rejections. The body binds replayed=false (initial response schema).

400.description: Malformed batch, unknown contract/version, or malformed idempotency key.

403.description: Insufficient permission to submit economics telemetry for this scope.

409.description: Idempotency conflict — the same key was submitted with a different body. Stored events are immutable and are never overwritten.

422.description: Every event in the batch was rejected. NOT a generic error envelope: the body binds replayed=false and carries the full counts/rejections detail — the exact same shape as 201 (initial response schema), distinguished only by the status code.

500.description: Internal error — either an unhandled ingestion failure, or an internal invariant breach where the service would have emitted a response that fails the response contract (never shipped; mapped to a stable, client-safe 500 instead).

503.description: The authoritative economics telemetry contract is unavailable (schema directory or a required schema file missing). Fails closed rather than validating against an absent or partial contract.

post.x-wrap-status: unclassified — economics telemetry is not in the #136 wrap-map; the documented response is the bare ingest-result shape. Reconcile envelope status when backend ingestion lands.
post.x-traigent-note: Tenant scoping is resolved from the authenticated request context. The contract carries no tenant field precisely so a client cannot assert one.
